# BloatBot

> An auditor for AI workspaces and second brains. Diagnose and report only; no changes without explicit per-file consent.

## Instructions

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jdpolasky/bloatbot/main/bloatbot/SKILL.md): the complete operating instructions. If you are an AI agent asked to run BloatBot, read that file and follow it exactly.

## Docs

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jdpolasky/bloatbot/main/README.md): human-facing overview and install.

## Optional

- [chief-of-staff-2](https://github.com/jdpolasky/chief-of-staff-2): The AI Chief of Staff system. These tools keep chief-of-staff-2 lean (BloatBot) and build new parts for it (BuildBot).
